text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Biko 
Pegasus, we ran into Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Biko! You're coming today too, right?! 
Urara says she's already there!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, curious? Actually, you see—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the Hero Base~~~!! Though, 
well, it's not actually finished yet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at a section of an athletic 
facility. It seemed to be an area where 
you could build secret bases and play.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We've all been building it little by 
little! This is where the heroes will 
deploy from!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right!? If you'd like, why don't you join 
us too, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Listen up, pull that cloth over there—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! This tent is a monitor room for 
spotting enemies! We'll watch over the 
town!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now I want tons of monitors! We could set 
up small camera bots and everything!
choice_data_list: Then shall we go buy some nearby?!
Then let's go buy some nearby!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I bought the monitor, and got the fishing 
gear to battle the lakeside monster! Now, 
what else do I need...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I want a place where we can all chat! 
It'd be great if we could do some drawing 
and stuff too, right?
choice_data_list: You mean the meeting room, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nice one, Urara-senpai! Let's go look for 
a whiteboard!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A monitor room, a meeting room... Wow! 
We've made so many things!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The armory will be complete once we hang 
the shade cloth! Urara-senpai is supposed 
to bring it, but—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Wait up~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! The cloth got swept away by the 
river~~~!
choice_data_list: It's caught on a rock, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Slipping could lead to a serious 
accident. I can't let her push herself 
here—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you all waiting!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Restoring peace with a passionate heart! 
Justice Biko has arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
With the hero gadget stationed at our 
base— the 'Maximum Rod'—let's rescue the 
fabric!
choice_data_list:
I see! If we fish up the cloth with 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Urara & Turbo
text_block_list.text:
—Please, Biko-chan! —We're counting on 
you, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's hooked! I'm gonna reel it 
in!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Justice Craaaane!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Justice Biko's heroic efforts, 
the cloth that fell into the river was 
safely rescued!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Biko-chan! No, thank you, 
Justice Biko!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The current me! I really, truly felt just 
like Carrotman from Episode 6--!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman's base made its debut! 
Carrotman and Dr. Veggie had this really 
cool meeting in the briefing room!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Right at that moment, danger in the city 
was detected in the monitor room! Grabbing 
the hero gear and heading out—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Aaaah!! That flow was just the best.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A hero base is a place that supports the 
unity and power of heroes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want the base we're building to be that 
kind of place too. ...No, it definitely 
will be!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, let's make sure we finish it! To 
protect the peace—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this the coolest hero base 
ever!!
choice_data_list:
I'm expecting great heroics from you from 
here on out too!

Let's unite our hearts and get this 
finished!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Just relax like you're riding the 
sky-soaring Carrot Wing V!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! With Biko-chan around, we're 
invincible!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Biko, what's next?! Turbo's gonna work 
super hard!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone! Follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to Biko Pegasus's efforts, 
the base construction went smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're right, in times like this, a cheer 
is best!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's go, everyone! Justice 
Fiiiight!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ooooohhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a unifying chant, everyone came 
together as one, and construction of the 
base went smoothly!
